headline: Modality-stratified representations retained (no shared representation supported)
reasons: No representation materially beats the direct_SNV held-out cross-modal baseline (top1=0.275, MRR=0.452); best held-out MRR = 0.460 (I1_regions). Retain modality-stratified representations; align at ontology level.
source_generalization_caveat: Ag-SERS is single-source (Gobbato); leave-source-out is impossible for SERS. Cross-modal results are within the present 785 nm matched corpus, NOT observation-domain-invariant.
